theme: Light mode default, dark mode toggle. Healthcare apps perform best in light, high-contrast modes for legibility, especially for older adults.

rules: Use IBM Plex Sans for all lab data and numbers to ensure monospaced-like alignment.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards. shadow-lg only for floating bottom nav or modals.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px border-border/40 on cards. Use soft rounded corners (rounded-2xl) to feel like a companion rather than a sterile clinical tool.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Forbidden for medical data. Use only for sticky headers/bottom nav if content scrolls under, but ensure high opacity (e.g., bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) so text doesn't become illegible.

components.bottom_navigation: Fixed bottom, solid white background (not transparent), z-50. Phosphor Icons (size 24). Active state uses Deep Forest Green with a subtle background pill.
components.cards: Cardless or minimal outline cards. p-4 or p-6. No heavy drop shadows.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions to feel approachable. Min height 48px for tap targets.
components.charts: Recharts. Use simple Area or Line charts for eGFR/Creatinine. Ensure dots on data points are large (r=4 or 6) for easy tapping/reading.

layouts.mobile_first: Max-w-md mx-auto for mobile layout if viewed on desktop. True mobile-first approach. Safe area padding at bottom for nav.
layouts.dashboard: Bento-lite grid. 1 column on mobile, 2 on tablet. Generous spacing (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.check_in: Step-by-step full-screen wizard. One question per screen. Large touch targets.

motion.micro_interactions: Tap scale (scale: 0.98) on cards and buttons.
motion.check_in_wizard: Framer motion AnimatePresence slide left/right between questions.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. All text over primary green must be white.
accessibility.color_independence: Status indicators (like KDIGO risk) must include an icon or text label (e.g. 'High Risk [!]'), not just color.
accessibility.data_testid: Required on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='log-symptom-button').

onboarding_senior.description: Elderly man happily holding a bowl of fresh vegetables indoors, promoting healthy lifestyle.

doctor_consult.description: A doctor and patient engaging in a positive consultation in a bright clinic setting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app with a fixed bottom navigation bar containing: Home, Check-in, Reports, Insights, Timeline, Profile.
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text and numbers.
Ensure all tap targets (buttons, list items) are at least 48px tall.
Implement the Dashboard with greeting, today's check-in card, latest measurements grid (eGFR, Creatinine), and Reminders.
The Daily Check-in should be a fast <60s flow, potentially a wizard or a very clean single page.
Insights page must include Recharts line charts for eGFR/Creatinine and a KDIGO GFRxACR educational heatmap.
Timeline page should be a chronological list of events (reports, doctor visits, medication changes).
Vrikka AI Chat can be a floating FAB or accessible from the nav.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' gradients or heavy glassmorphism. Use solid, soft earthy tones with crisp borders to build medical trust.
Apply guidelines to .js files, not .tsx files. You have a React JS template, write standard JSX.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS. Let text naturally flow left-aligned.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Never use generic placeholder images or AI assistant emojis for icons.
